fact: = |Left join[customer.c_custkey = orders.o_custkey](customer, orders where orders.o_totalprice > 300000.00) where customer.c_acctbal > 5000.00|
= |group[lineitem.l_orderkey](lineitem) where "value"."sum(lineitem.l_quantity) of group[lineitem.l_orderkey](lineitem)" > 100.00|
= |group[lineitem.l_orderkey](lineitem) where "value"."sum(lineitem.l_quantity) of group[lineitem.l_orderkey](lineitem)" > 200.00|
= |group[orders.o_custkey](orders) where orders.o_custkey < 500|
= |group["orders@1".o_custkey](orders@1) where "orders@1".o_custkey < 500 and exists["orders@1".o_custkey + 1 = "orders@2".o_custkey](orders@2)|
= |customer|
= |lineitem|

= |lineitem@1 × aggregate(aggregate(lineitem@2)) where CAST("lineitem@1".l_extendedprice AS DOUBLE) > "value"."first_value(""value"".""avg(lineitem.l_extendedprice) of aggregate(lineitem)"") of aggregate(aggregate(lineitem))"|
= |nation|
= |nation where (nation.n_name = 'FRANCE' OR nation.n_name = 'GERMANY')|
= |nation × supplier where (nation.n_name = 'FRANCE' OR nation.n_name = 'GERMANY') and nation.n_nationkey = supplier.s_nationkey|
= |nation × supplier where nation.n_nationkey = supplier.s_nationkey|
= |orders|
= |part|
= |supplier|
= |Full join[customer.c_custkey = orders.o_custkey, orders.o_totalprice > 300000.00](customer, orders)|
= |group[lineitem.l_orderkey](lineitem)|
= |group[orders.o_custkey](orders)|

= s(CAST("lineitem@1".l_extendedprice AS DOUBLE) > "value"."first_value(""value"".""avg(lineitem.l_extendedprice) of aggregate(lineitem)"") of aggregate(aggregate(lineitem))" | lineitem@1 × aggregate(aggregate(lineitem@2)))
= s(customer.c_acctbal > 5000.00 | Full join[customer.c_custkey = orders.o_custkey, orders.o_totalprice > 300000.00](customer, orders))
= s((nation.n_name = 'FRANCE' OR nation.n_name = 'GERMANY') | nation)
= s((nation.n_name = 'FRANCE' OR nation.n_name = 'GERMANY') | nation × supplier where nation.n_nationkey = supplier.s_nationkey)
= s((nation.n_name = 'FRANCE' OR nation.n_name = 'GERMANY') and nation.n_nationkey = supplier.s_nationkey | nation × supplier)
= s(nation.n_nationkey = supplier.s_nationkey | nation × supplier)
= s(nation.n_nationkey = supplier.s_nationkey | nation × supplier where (nation.n_name = 'FRANCE' OR nation.n_name = 'GERMANY'))
= s(orders.o_custkey < 500 | group[orders.o_custkey](orders))
= s("orders@1".o_custkey + 1 = "orders@2".o_custkey | group["orders@1".o_custkey](orders@1) × group["orders@2".o_custkey](orders@2) where "orders@1".o_custkey < 500)
= s("value"."sum(lineitem.l_quantity) of group[lineitem.l_orderkey](lineitem)" > 100.00 | group[lineitem.l_orderkey](lineitem))
= s("value"."sum(lineitem.l_quantity) of group[lineitem.l_orderkey](lineitem)" > 200.00 | group[lineitem.l_orderkey](lineitem))
= ndv(customer.c_mktsegment, customer.c_nationkey | customer)
= ndv(lineitem.l_orderkey | lineitem)
= ndv(lineitem.l_suppkey | lineitem)
= ndv(orders.o_custkey | orders)
= ndv(orders.o_orderkey | orders)
= unique(orders.o_orderkey | orders)

<= |customer where customer.c_acctbal > 0.00 and (substr(customer.c_phone, 1, 2) = '13' OR substr(customer.c_phone, 1, 2) = '17' OR substr(customer.c_phone, 1, 2) = '18' OR substr(customer.c_phone, 1, 2) = '23' OR substr(customer.c_phone, 1, 2) = '29' OR substr(customer.c_phone, 1, 2) = '30' OR substr(customer.c_phone, 1, 2) = '31')|
<= |customer where customer.c_acctbal > 5000.00|

<= |customer where customer.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING'|

<= |customer where (substr(customer.c_phone, 1, 2) = '13' OR substr(customer.c_phone, 1, 2) = '17' OR substr(customer.c_phone, 1, 2) = '18' OR substr(customer.c_phone, 1, 2) = '23' OR substr(customer.c_phone, 1, 2) = '29' OR substr(customer.c_phone, 1, 2) = '30' OR substr(customer.c_phone, 1, 2) = '31')|

<= |customer × lineitem × nation × orders × region × supplier where customer.c_custkey <= 1499 and customer.c_custkey = orders.o_custkey and customer.c_nationkey = nation.n_nationkey and customer.c_nationkey = supplier.s_nationkey and lineitem.l_orderkey = orders.o_orderkey and lineitem.l_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey and nation.n_regionkey = "region".r_regionkey and orders.o_orderdate < CAST('1995-01-01' AS DATE) and orders.o_orderdate >= CAST('1994-01-01' AS DATE) and "region".r_name = 'ASIA'|

<= |customer × lineitem × nation@1 × nation@2 × orders × part × region × supplier where customer.c_custkey <= 1499 and customer.c_custkey = orders.o_custkey and customer.c_nationkey = "nation@1".n_nationkey and lineitem.l_orderkey = orders.o_orderkey and lineitem.l_partkey = "part".p_partkey and lineitem.l_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey and "nation@1".n_regionkey = "region".r_regionkey and "nation@2".n_nationkey = supplier.s_nationkey and orders.o_orderdate <= CAST('1996-12-31' AS DATE) and orders.o_orderdate >= CAST('1995-01-01' AS DATE) and "part".p_type = 'ECONOMY ANODIZED STEEL' and "region".r_name = 'AMERICA'|

<= |customer × lineitem × nation@1 × nation@2 × orders × supplier where customer.c_custkey <= 1499 and customer.c_custkey = orders.o_custkey and customer.c_nationkey = "nation@1".n_nationkey and lineitem.l_orderkey = orders.o_orderkey and lineitem.l_shipdate <= CAST('1996-12-31' AS DATE) and lineitem.l_shipdate >= CAST('1995-01-01' AS DATE) and lineitem.l_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey and ("nation@1".n_name = 'FRANCE' OR "nation@1".n_name = 'GERMANY') and ("nation@2".n_name = 'FRANCE' OR "nation@2".n_name = 'GERMANY') and "nation@2".n_nationkey = supplier.s_nationkey|

<= |customer × orders where customer.c_custkey <= 1499 and customer.c_custkey = orders.o_custkey and orders.o_totalprice > 300000.00|

<= ndv(lineitem.l_orderkey, lineitem.l_suppkey | lineitem × nation × orders × supplier where lineitem.l_orderkey = orders.o_orderkey and lineitem.l_receiptdate > lineitem.l_commitdate and lineitem.l_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey and nation.n_name = 'SAUDI ARABIA' and nation.n_nationkey = supplier.s_nationkey and orders.o_orderstatus = 'F')

<= ndv(lineitem.l_orderkey, orders.o_orderdate, orders.o_shippriority | customer × lineitem × orders where customer.c_custkey <= 1499 and customer.c_custkey = orders.o_custkey and customer.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' and lineitem.l_orderkey = orders.o_orderkey and lineitem.l_shipdate > CAST('1995-03-15' AS DATE) and orders.o_orderdate < CAST('1995-03-15' AS DATE))
<= ndv(lineitem.l_partkey | lineitem × part where lineitem.l_partkey = "part".p_partkey and "part".p_brand = 'Brand#23' and "part".p_container = 'MED BOX')

<= ndv(lineitem.l_shipmode | lineitem × orders where lineitem.l_orderkey = orders.o_orderkey and lineitem.l_receiptdate < CAST('1995-01-01' AS DATE) and lineitem.l_receiptdate > lineitem.l_commitdate and lineitem.l_receiptdate >= CAST('1994-01-01' AS DATE) and lineitem.l_shipdate < lineitem.l_commitdate and (lineitem.l_shipmode = 'MAIL' OR lineitem.l_shipmode = 'SHIP'))
<= ndv(lineitem.l_suppkey | lineitem where lineitem.l_quantity < 10.00)
<= ndv(lineitem.l_suppkey | lineitem where lineitem.l_shipdate < CAST('1996-04-01' AS DATE) and lineitem.l_shipdate >= CAST('1996-01-01' AS DATE))
<= ndv(lineitem.l_suppkey | lineitem where lineitem.l_suppkey < 50)

<= ndv(nation.n_name | customer × lineitem × nation × orders × region × supplier where customer.c_custkey <= 1499 and customer.c_custkey = orders.o_custkey and customer.c_nationkey = nation.n_nationkey and customer.c_nationkey = supplier.s_nationkey and lineitem.l_orderkey = orders.o_orderkey and lineitem.l_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey and nation.n_regionkey = "region".r_regionkey and orders.o_orderdate < CAST('1995-01-01' AS DATE) and orders.o_orderdate >= CAST('1994-01-01' AS DATE) and "region".r_name = 'ASIA')
<= ndv(orders.o_orderkey | orders where orders.o_orderdate < CAST('1993-10-01' AS DATE) and orders.o_orderdate >= CAST('1993-07-01' AS DATE))
<= ndv(orders.o_orderpriority | customer × orders where customer.c_custkey <= 1499 and customer.c_custkey = orders.o_custkey and customer.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING')

<= ndv("part".p_partkey | nation × part × partsupp × region × supplier where ends_with("part".p_type, 'BRASS') and nation.n_nationkey = supplier.s_nationkey and nation.n_regionkey = "region".r_regionkey and "part".p_partkey = partsupp.ps_partkey and "part".p_size = 15 and partsupp.ps_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey and "region".r_name = 'EUROPE')
<= ndv(partsupp.ps_partkey | nation × partsupp × supplier where nation.n_name = 'GERMANY' and nation.n_nationkey = supplier.s_nationkey and partsupp.ps_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey)
<= ndv(partsupp.ps_partkey, partsupp.ps_suppkey | partsupp where exists["part".p_partkey = partsupp.ps_partkey](part where "part".p_name < 'foresu' and "part".p_name >= 'forest'))
